title: The logic of bunched implications is undecidable
summary: The logic of bunched implications (BI), introduced by O'Hearn and Pym (1999), has attracted significant attention due to its elegant proof calculus, varied semantics, and close connections to the propositional fragment of separation logic. We show here that provability in BI is undecidable by encoding Wang tilings into its ternary relational semantics. Equivalently, this yields the undecidability of the equational theory of BI-algebras.
